# ROOT

ROOT Revenue Operations & Outcomes Technology Incorporated connects healthcare revenue-cycle management, credentialing, practice operations, data architecture, automation, analytics, and DIRT (Data Intelligence for Revenue Transformation).

## What ROOT does

ROOT helps healthcare practices review revenue-cycle performance, identify patterns in denials and aging accounts receivable, organize credentialing and operating work, and connect findings to owners and follow-up measures. DIRT is ROOT's data-intelligence method for connecting deidentified, authorized reports to prioritized operational decisions.

## Engagement details

The published Revenue Optimization Diagnostic is a fixed-fee $2,500 engagement for independent practices. Other services and projects are scoped to specialty, volume, payer mix, systems, and operating needs. No financial recovery outcome is guaranteed.

## Evidence and privacy

Dashboard figures and practice profiles on this site are labeled illustrative sample data; they are not represented as client results. Public website forms are for commercial inquiries only. Do not submit protected health information, patient records, or patient identifiers.
